Both La Calahorra and Collado del Alguacil make their debuts as La Vuelta stage towns.
The full list of new stage towns in this edition: Monaco (stage 1), Manosque (2), Font-Romeu (stage 3), Falset (5), Roquetes (5), Vall d’Alba (7), Puçol (8), Xeraco (8), La Vila Joiosa (9), Alcaraz (10), Elche de la Sierra (10), Vera (12), Almuñécar (13), Palma del Rio (15), Cortegana (16), La Rábida (16), Dos Hermanas (17), El Puerto de Santa María (18), La Calahorra (20), and Collado del Alguacil (20)."],"updatedBy":"bvittek","_id":"db90b7eaf7d5982fa5aaa7409a96fc9228f2607152b1d9100756c18c691a72ed","_bind":"publication_en-2026-20","_origin":"news-2026-20","_updatedAt":1789207977068,"_parent":"stage-2026:60085cf1da502cd2d041ebe70ecdb2b26a400b8f2af186e7693696bfda2e3b32","_key":"_id","_virtual":"news:welcome-back-to-granada","model":"news"}]
